items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: he wrote me to come out there with him. And then I could get a chance to play in the band. So I did

ctx.x: Well when you got out of school and you went to California and then you were playing with Les Hite? Is that right? And then Louis came out and you were supporting his group and he was playing with you.

No. Les Hite is a guy that I knew around Chicago when we was kids coming up. And Les Hite was a really good saxophone player. And he got out in California and he wrote me to come out there with him. And then I could get a chance to play in the band. So I did and I wrote back and told him, and my grandmother let me come, and I told him I’d be out there to join the band.
